# Juno — instructions for AI agents working in this repository

Read `CLAUDE.md` first. It is the single source of truth for architecture rules,
the backend-owns-logic / frontend-is-display boundary, build and test commands,
and the mandatory `cargo check` after any Rust change.

Then, depending on the task:

- Agent responses (text + voice + JSX components): `docs/specs/AGENT_RESPONSE_SPEC.md`
- Backend modules and commands: `docs/backend/`, `docs/api/API.md`
- Frontend components, events, state: `docs/frontend/`
- Plans and open work: `docs/plans/`
- Audits (security, competitive, voice models): `docs/audits/`
- Releases: `docs/development/RELEASES.md`

The previous 1,200-line version of this file is preserved at
`docs/legacy/LLMs-2025.txt` for history only; its status claims are stale.
